jobs.title: Interesting Job Opportunity: Vehant Technologies - Senior Cyber Security Engineer - DLP & MDM Solutions
jobs.description:
Role : Cyber Security Engineer (DLP & MDM)

Experience : 6 - 10 years

Work mode : Onsite (5 Days a week from office)

Job Location : Sector-59, Noida

Qualification : Engineering/BCA.

Role Overview

Vehant Technologies is seeking a Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer with strong experience in secure, mission-critical IT environments. The role involves designing, managing, and securing IT infrastructure supporting Vehant's security solutions, including R&D systems, production environments, and deployed customer systems. Candidates with prior experience in private defence companies or regulated environments will be strongly preferred.

About The Role

Vehant Technologies is looking for a proactive Cyber Security Engineer to strengthen our cybersecurity infrastructure and help us build a secure enterprise environment. We have already procured our Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions and are looking for a professional who can lead their implementation, deployment, integration, and ongoing administration in a Linux-centric enterprise environment. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Linux administration, enterprise security, endpoint security, network security, and automation using shell scripting. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the organization's overall cybersecurity strategy and establish best security practices across the IT environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Implement, configure, deploy, and manage enterprise DLP and MDM solutions.
• Define and enforce data protection and endpoint security policies across the organization.
• Secure Linux endpoints and ensure compliance with organizational security standards.
• Administer and harden Linux systems using industry best practices.
• Configure and manage firewalls, VPNs, switches, and routers to maintain a secure network infrastructure.
• Monitor security events, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
• Conduct vulnerability assessments and recommend remediation measures.
• Develop and automate administrative and security tasks using Shell/Bash scripting.
• Collaborate with IT, Infrastructure, and Development teams to strengthen the organization's security posture.
• Prepare security documentation, SOPs, and implementation guidelines.
• Stay updated with emerging cybersecurity threats and recommend improvements to existing security controls.

Required Skills

• 6+ years of experience in Cyber Security, Infrastructure Security, or Network Security.
• Hands-on experience implementing or administering DLP solutions.
• Experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms.
• Strong Linux administration experience (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS, or similar).
• Good knowledge of Shell/Bash scripting.
• Experience with enterprise firewalls, VPNs, routing, and switching.
• Understanding of endpoint security, access control, data protection, and security hardening.
• Knowledge of security monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Why Join Us?

• Opportunity to lead the implementation of enterprise-grade DLP and MDM solutions.
• Work in a Linux-heavy, technology-driven environment.
• Play a key role in shaping the organization's cybersecurity strategy and security culture.
• Collaborate with experienced engineering and infrastructure teams on impactful security initiatives.

jobs.title: Principal AI Security Architect
jobs.description:
About Position:

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal AI Security Architect to lead the design and governance of security architecture across cloud, edge, on-premises, and mobile environments. This role will drive Zero Trust security strategies, secure AI and distributed systems, and establish robust identity, access management, and data protection frameworks. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, platform, and architecture teams to build secure, scalable, and compliant AI-powered solutions while ensuring security is embedded throughout the technology lifecycle

• Role: Principal AI Security Architect
• Location: Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad
• Experience: Between 12 to 15 Years
• Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do:

• Define and govern end-to-end security architecture across device, edge, on-premises, cloud, and hybrid ecosystems.
• Design and implement Zero Trust security architectures leveraging workload identity, PKI, mTLS, JWT, hardware-backed credentials, and trust federation.
• Architect authentication, authorization, secrets management, credential lifecycle management, and privileged access controls.
• Establish secure identity frameworks for users, workloads, services, applications, and AI agents.
• Lead threat modeling activities for distributed systems, AI/ML platforms, APIs, multi-agent systems, and edge-to-cloud communications.
• Develop security strategies for AI-powered platforms, intelligent agents, orchestration engines, APIs, plugins, tools, registries, and model interactions.
• Define security controls for Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI orchestration frameworks.
• Conduct architecture reviews and security assessments to identify vulnerabilities, risks, and mitigation strategies.
• Establish enterprise-wide security governance standards, design patterns, and best practices.
• Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to integrate security controls into application and infrastructure architectures.
• Drive implementation of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices and DevSecOps methodologies.
• Ensure compliance with security regulations, industry standards, and enterprise governance requirements.
• Define data protection, encryption, tokenization, and privacy strategies across AI and distributed environments.
• Support incident response preparation, security investigations, and threat mitigation initiatives.
• Guide security modernization initiatives across cloud-native and distributed technology platforms.
• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to security and engineering teams.

Expertise You'll Bring:

• 12 to 15 years of experience in Security Architecture, Enterprise Security Engineering, Platform Security, or Cybersecurity Leadership roles.
• Proven expertise in designing and implementing Zero Trust security architectures.
• Strong experience with authentication, authorization, identity and access management (IAM), and federated identity solutions.
• Deep knowledge of PKI, mTLS, JWT, certificate-based authentication, and trust federation architectures.
• Extensive experience securing cloud-native, distributed, edge, mobile, and on-premises platforms.
• Strong understanding of workload identity, secrets management, credential lifecycle management, and privileged access controls.
• Experience working with trust federation frameworks such as SPIFFE/SPIRE or equivalent technologies.
• Hands-on experience conducting threat modeling, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and security governance initiatives.
• Strong expertise in securing APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and service-to-service communications.
• Knowledge of AI/ML security, Generative AI security, Agentic AI, RAG architectures, and multi-agent ecosystems.
• Experience implementing security controls for AI models, orchestration platforms, vector databases, prompts, and inference services.
• Strong understanding of Kubernetes security, container security, cloud platform security, and infrastructure hardening.
• Experience securing software supply chains and implementing secure development and deployment practices.
• Knowledge of DevSecOps, vulnerability management, compliance frameworks, and security monitoring.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
• Ability to influence enterprise security strategy and collaborate with engineering, architecture, and business leadership teams.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
• Experience leading enterprise-scale security transformation and modernization initiatives.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary and benefits package
• Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
• Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
• Annual health check-ups
• Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

• We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
• Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
• If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."

jobs.title: Security Operations Center Analyst
jobs.description:
We're hiring: SOC Analyst (L1/L2) | Mumbai

At Risknox, we're building out our Security Operations Centre in Mumbai, and we're looking for an analyst who wants to do more than watch alerts.

In this role you'll monitor and respond to real threats for our clients. You'll also help configure the SOC from the ground up, and work directly with our product team to improve Pulse, our SIEM and EDR platform. Your detections and fixes will ship in the product.

What you'll do

→ Triage, investigate and respond to alerts across endpoints, firewalls, servers and cloud

→ Contain incidents using EDR and escalate as per playbooks

→ Onboard clients: deploy agents, connect log sources, build parsers

→ Write and tune detection rules, dashboards and playbooks mapped to MITRE ATT&CK

→ Automate enrichment and response with Python, PowerShell or Bash

→ Shape Pulse by testing releases and turning analyst pain points into features

What we're looking for

✔ 2–3 years in a SOC, MSSP or security monitoring role

✔ Hands-on with a SIEM (Wazuh, Elastic, Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar or similar) and an EDR/XDR tool

✔ Has configured log sources, parsers or detection rules, not just consumed alerts

✔ Strong grasp of Windows, Linux, Active Directory and network fundamentals

✔ Scripting skills and clear written communication

✔ Based in Mumbai or willing to relocate; open to rotational shifts

Good to have: Wazuh/Sigma/MISP experience; familiarity with CERT-In reporting and the DPDP Act

Why Risknox
• A real say in how a SOC and its platform get built
• A clear growth path towards L3, detection engineering or threat hunting
• exposure to clients across India and the GCC
• An award-winning team (Best Innovative Cybersecurity Solution, GISEC Global 2025)

📍 Mumbai, on-site | 💼 Full-time | 🧭 2–3 years

jobs.title: Technical Consultant-Threat Detection Response & Intelligence
jobs.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Technical Consultant: Threat Detection Response & Intelligence, you play a vital role in safeguarding an organization's digital infrastructure by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating cyber threats. This position involves using a variety of cybersecurity tools to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

• Conduct Event Investigations: Investigate security incidents using SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, and apply industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
• Manage Incident Reports: Prioritize and manage incident reports, providing actionable recommendations and responses to strengthen the client's security posture.
• Analyze Network and Endpoint Events: Interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
• Engage in Vulnerability Management: Participate in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
• Provide Actionable Recommendations: Deliver recommendations and responses to clients to enhance their security posture.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

• Exposure to Cybersecurity Tools: Familiarity with a variety of cybersecurity tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
• Understanding of Industry Frameworks: Knowledge of industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
• Experience with Network and Endpoint Analysis: Ability to interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
• Exposure to Vulnerability Management: Participation in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
• Certification in Security Technologies: Familiarity with security technologies and certifications related to threat detection, response, and intelligence.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

• Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash is beneficial for automating tasks and interacting with various cybersecurity tools.
• Knowledge of Cloud Security: Understanding cloud security principles and experience working with cloud-based security solutions can be advantageous in identifying and mitigating cyber threats.
• Exposure to Threat Intelligence Platforms: Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and feeds can aid in staying up-to-date with emerging threats and improving incident response capabilities.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Required Skills: Dark Web Research, OSINT, Threat Intelligence, DRPS / Brand Protection, VAPT, Compliance (ISO 27001, CERT-In, RBI), and Customer-Facing Security Support.

Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our team working on Digital Risk Protection (DRPS) and Brand Protection solutions. This is a hybrid role: part hands-on threat analysis and dark web research, part customer-facing support and onboarding, and part product work alongside our engineering team. You will also mentor junior analysts and help shape how our platform detects and reports digital risk.

Project Role Description:

Dark Web Research and Threat Monitoring, Incident Triage and Escalation, Customer Onboarding and Success for the DRPS / Brand Protection Platform, VAPT Support and Vulnerability Tracking, Compliance Reporting (ISO 27001, RBI, CERT-In), Mentoring Junior Analysts, and Product Collaboration on Detection Logic and Platform Improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

Threat Monitoring & Analysis
• Conduct dark web research and monitor underground forums, marketplaces, and paste sites for customer-relevant exposure.
• Monitor threat dashboards and dark web monitoring platforms on a daily basis.
• Perform log analysis, triage security incidents, and escalate advanced threats to the appropriate teams.
• Work with threat intelligence feeds and tools to enrich and validate findings.

Customer Success & Support
• Own customer onboarding for our DRPS / Brand Protection platform.
• Provide day-to-day support for product alerts, false-positive reviews, and customer queries.
• Act as the security subject-matter expert during customer calls and reviews.

Vulnerability Management & VAPT
• Support VAPT engagements, reporting, and vulnerability tracking through to closure.
• Ensure endpoint security and patching practices are followed and documented.

Reporting & Compliance
• Produce daily and weekly threat reports and compliance summaries for internal and customer stakeholders.
• Map findings to relevant compliance requirements (ISO 27001, RBI guidelines, CERT-In directions).

Team & Product
• Train and mentor junior analysts, and review their analysis and reports.
• Work with product and engineering teams on new features, detection logic, and platform improvements based on field experience.

Must-Have Skills:
• 1+ years in a security analyst, SOC, or threat intelligence role.
• Hands-on experience with dark web research and OSINT investigation techniques.
• Working knowledge of DRPS / Digital Risk Protection or Brand Protection solutions.
• Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and the vulnerability management lifecycle.
• Experience with VAPT: performing tests or reviewing and reporting on findings.
• Security fundamentals across Windows, Linux, and cloud environments.
• Exposure to threat intelligence feeds, platforms, and tooling.
• Awareness of compliance frameworks: ISO 27001, RBI cybersecurity guidelines, and CERT-In basics.
• Strong written communication and comfort in a customer-facing role.

Good to Have:
• Certifications such as CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
• Scripting ability (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) for automation and enrichment.
• Experience with SIEM platforms and writing detection rules.
• Prior experience in a product or SaaS security company.
• Familiarity with takedown processes for phishing domains, fake apps, and impersonation profiles.

Educational Qualification:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Cyber Security, or a related field.
• Candidates with advanced certifications (CEH, OSCP, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor) or equivalent hands-on experience will be preferred.

Perks:
• Ownership of customer relationships as the security subject-matter expert.
• Direct influence on product detection logic and the platform roadmap.
• Leadership experience through mentoring and reviewing junior analysts.
• Exposure across the full DRPS lifecycle: monitoring, takedowns, VAPT, and compliance.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Incident Response Lead / Information Security Director
jobs.description:
🌟 We're Hiring: Cybersecurity Incident Response Lead / Information Security Director

📍 Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote)

🕒 Employment Type: Part-Time

💼 Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior

🌐 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
About Us

We are a globally focused organization committed to protecting digital assets, business operations, and customer information through strong cybersecurity practices. Our teams combine security strategy, threat intelligence, technology, governance, and incident management to strengthen organizational resilience. We value security, integrity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
The Role

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Incident Response Lead / Information Security Director to lead security incident response, information security strategy, risk management, and cyber resilience initiatives. The ideal candidate combines hands-on incident response expertise with strategic leadership and the ability to translate complex security risks into practical business priorities.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain cybersecurity incident response strategies, procedures, and playbooks.
• Lead the detection, analysis, containment, investigation, and recovery of security incidents.
• Coordinate incident response activities across IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business teams.
• Establish and monitor security operations, incident-management, and cyber-resilience processes.
• Assess emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack patterns, and potential business impacts.
• Lead post-incident reviews and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
• Develop information-security policies, standards, controls, and governance frameworks.
• Conduct security risk assessments and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Oversee vulnerability management, security monitoring, access controls, and threat-detection initiatives.
• Support security architecture and technology decisions from a risk-management perspective.
• Monitor security metrics, incident trends, control effectiveness, and organizational risk exposure.
• Coordinate security assessments, audits, penetration-testing activities, and compliance reviews.
• Manage relationships with security vendors, managed security providers, and external specialists.
• Develop and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber-crisis response plans.
• Provide security awareness guidance and promote a strong cybersecurity culture across the organization.
• Prepare executive-level security reports, risk summaries, incident updates, and strategic recommendations.
Requirements
• 3+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity, information security, incident response, security operations, or a related field preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline preferred.
• Strong understanding of incident response, threat detection, vulnerability management, and security risk management.
• Experience handling security incidents from initial detection through containment, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
• Knowledge of security frameworks, controls, governance practices, and risk-management principles.
• Strong analytical, investigative, decision-making, and crisis-management skills.
• Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience with SIEM, EDR, vulnerability-management, identity-security, and security-monitoring technologies.
• Strong understanding of cloud, network, endpoint, application, and data-security concepts.
• Ability to manage confidential information and operate effectively under pressure.
• Strong leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities within a remote environment.
• Professional certifications are not required unless specifically relevant to the role.
What We Offer
• Flexible part-time work with a fully remote arrangement.
• Opportunity to lead meaningful cybersecurity and organizational resilience initiatives.
• Exposure to international technology environments, security challenges, and executive stakeholders.
• Access to modern security, monitoring, collaboration, and analytical technologies.
• Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
• Professional growth across cybersecurity leadership, incident response, governance, and risk management.
• A collaborative environment focused on security excellence, innovation, resilience, and continuous improvement.
